reviews.reviewText: Almost 50% was choose the correct word/synonym/antonym/punctuation/errors. Topics: Thesis statement, Pronoun reference, Sentence fragments, Fused sentences, Dangler, Parts of paragraph, Purposes of Essay writing.
Paper sara Grammar based aur conceptual tha. Majority part grammar ka tha aur sara handouts mein se tha. Files karne ki koi zarorat nahi hai. Handouts ko achy se read karein paper hojaye ga.

Topics covered: Preposition, Composition, Interjection, Fill in the blanks, Correct spelling, Tenses (Past, Present, Future), Synonyms, Antonyms.
Special Note: Essay writing topic is very important (How to structure an essay?). There were many questions regarding this, so memorize the important points of essay writing.

Questions were knowledge-based, like mid term.
Topics:
- Active voice / Passive voice.
- Prepositions.
- Grammatical errors.
- 80 MCQs total.
